sents.t: Hana Ito (2:50 P.M.): The projector in Room 5 isn't working. The client arrives in ten minutes.
Ben Clark (2:51 P.M.): Did you check the cable?
Hana Ito (2:52 P.M.): Yes. It's connected properly.
Ben Clark (2:53 P.M.): Room 7 has a new projector. It's free until four.
Hana Ito (2:54 P.M.): Perfect. I'll move there. Could you put a sign on Room 5's door?
Ben Clark (2:55 P.M.): Sure. Also, the remote has no batteries. That might have been the problem.
